purpose: Execute the atomic resolve-face-semantically operation within the MA-29 boundary: Root-only semantic face resolver supporting a bounded predicate subset: axis-aligned bbox, area, and outward planar normal. It does not support arbitrary adjacency or a host semantic-selector API.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires resolve-face-semantically and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Current root body whose faces are enumerated.

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.description: Nonempty subset of bbox_mm, normal, and area_mm2.

inputs.name: normal_tolerance
inputs.description: Required when criteria contains normal; normal matching is limited to planar faces.

preconditions: body is a current root DesignBody and passes assert_closed.
criteria is nonempty and contains only bbox_mm, normal, and/or area_mm2.
Any branch-specific tolerances are finite and nonnegative.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The unique face matching all supported criteria.

postconditions: Faces are freshly enumerated and exactly one face passes every supplied predicate; one(...) returns it.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic resolve-face-semantically operation within the MA-29 boundary: Root-only semantic face resolver supporting a bounded predicate subset: axis-aligned bbox, area, and outward planar normal. It does not support arbitrary adjacency or a host semantic-selector API. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches raise through one(...).
Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: list(body.Faces) is obtained at call time; re-resolve after topology mutation.

failure_modes.condition: Empty criteria or unsupported keys raise ValueError.
failure_modes.detection: Empty criteria or unsupported keys raise ValueError.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: one(...) finds zero or multiple matches.
failure_modes.detection: one(...) finds zero or multiple matches.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

recovery.action: Use only the supported predicate subset and branch tolerances.
Tighten geometric criteria/tolerance or stop; no model mutation requires rollback.
